name: 死之执政·若娜瓦
src: 底卡 #97、#99（显相）；门面重做_方向稿.md 第五节；牌桌第十六版的手；语料/门面参考_11-10/执政_若娜瓦_头.png；11-15 第二回：用户给的两张官方图（archon_ronova_ref1、ref2），脸和本相的衣装照它，多突出黑丝；11-15 第三回：正装改姿势和手势（用户：“若娜瓦正装姿势手势可以改进一下”），照官方图那种一手抬到领口、一手往外张开爪子
ref_lead: The LAST 2 attached pictures show this exact being's official design. Follow them closely for her face (the soft face, the large amber-gold eyes, the small mouth, the calm, faintly blank expression), her hair and the crimson eye-shaped ornaments, the clawed black gloves, the flame-shaped crimson wings with glowing eye marks, and the design of her formal dress: the black bodice traced with crimson, the silver three-lobed knots at the hips, the layer of white petal-shaped panels, the long black and crimson flame-shaped train that is open at the front, the sheer black tights and the black heels. Do NOT copy their poses or camera angles: she stands upright and composed. Ignore their rendering and background.
who: Ronova, the Shade of Death, one of the four oldest beings of this world, in the shape of a grown woman who looks about twenty-five, about 170 cm, slender and graceful with long legs. Thick, straight silver-white hair falling to her knees, bangs falling between the eyes, a few locks framing the face and one long thin strand standing straight up at the crown; a soft, delicate face with large round amber-gold eyes under long lashes, a small nose and a small mouth, a calm, faintly blank, slightly sleepy expression; cool pale skin. Above each temple a crimson eye-shaped ornament with a plain dark-red centre, no white crescent and no curved white mark inside it. Her hands are always in long matte black gloves, each fingertip drawn out into a long sharp claw of the same black, no nails and no red, three thin silver-white lines along the little-finger side of each hand up the forearm. Her legs are always in sheer black tights: a fine semi-transparent black with a soft sheen, the skin tone showing faintly through on the lit side and deepening to solid black at the edges. Quiet, cool, faintly curious.
palette: black, crimson, silver-white, a touch of cold blue-green
casual: Walking unseen among the living, her wings gone: a long open black wool travelling coat over a knee-length black dress with a high collar and long fitted sleeves, the legs in the sheer black tights, black heeled ankle boots, the crimson eye ornaments shrunk to two small hairpins, the silver hair tied loosely low at the nape, the clawed black gloves on, a small iron lantern burning with a cold blue-green flame hanging from one hand.
private: At rest where no one sees her: a simple knee-length black dress with long fitted sleeves and a high neck, a thin silver-grey shawl over the shoulders, the legs in the sheer black tights, soft black flat shoes, the hair loose to the knees, the gloves still on, an old leather-bound ledger of names held against her chest with both hands, a faintly drowsy look.
formal: As the Shade of Death, in her official dress: a fitted black bodice with a high collar, traced with thin crimson lines and edged in silver; long black clawed gloves reaching above the elbows; at each hip a silver three-lobed knot with a crimson centre; from the hips a short layer of white petal-shaped panels, and below it a long flowing train of black and crimson flame-shaped panels that sweeps back to both sides and is open in front, so both legs are seen full-length in the sheer black tights with their soft sheen; black high heels with silver accents; behind her a pair of tall crimson wings shaped like rising flames, each set with glowing red eye marks, kept within her own space. She stands in a graceful three-quarter turn, her weight on one leg, the other leg crossed lightly in front with the knee bent and the heel lifted, her head tilted a little, her calm sleepy gaze on the viewer. One clawed hand is raised to her collarbone, the long black claws curled softly against the high collar; the other arm is held out low and a little to the side, palm turned up and the claws spread gently, as if inviting a soul to come to her. Elegant, unhurried and a little uncanny, never stiff.
art: A large close portrait: the amber-gold eyes lifting from under the lashes, a faint curve at one corner of the mouth, one clawed black-gloved hand resting at her high collar, silver hair falling across the frame; cold blue-green light from one side with a crimson rim light; blurred crimson eye-marked feathers drifting in the foreground.

name: 时之执政·伊斯塔露
src: 底卡 #97、#100（显相）；门面重做_方向稿.md 第五节；语料/门面参考_11-10/执政_伊斯塔露.png
ref_lead: The LAST attached picture shows this being's original design, for the details only: take from it the hair colour and hairstyle, the eye colour, the halo rings and golden pendulum ornaments, the gold anklets and bangles, and the colours and patterns of the gown. Do NOT copy its sitting pose, its camera angle, its body shape or how much skin it shows: here she stands, a dignified, fully dressed adult woman whose clothes follow the descriptions below. Ignore its rendering and background.
who: Istaroth, the Shade of Time, in the shape of a grown woman who looks about twenty-six, about 168 cm, slender and willowy. Extremely long silver-white hair that drifts slowly as if it were sand pouring through an hourglass, with one thin braid at the side; golden eyes nearly always lowered, sorrowful and tender, looking on every living thing in the same way; pale skin. Both hands are stained violet from the fingertips up to the wrists, the mark of carrying her task too long. She is always barefoot, with thin gold anklets, and wears thin gold bangles. Gentle, melancholy, patient beyond measure.
palette: white, gold, pale blue, soft violet
casual: Walking among the living: a long plain dove-grey dress with long fitted sleeves, a pale blue shawl over the shoulders, the hair gathered into one long loose braid, a small old brass hourglass held in her violet-tinged hands; she is barefoot as always, no shoes and no boots, only the thin gold anklets on her bare feet.
private: Alone and resting: a loose long white gown with soft sleeves, the hair loose and floating around her, barefoot, a dandelion seed head held up in one violet-tinged hand, watching a few seeds drift away, the faintest sad smile.
formal: As the Shade of Time: a long layered gown, the outer layers white edged with gold, the inner layers a gradient from pale blue to violet, three-cornered knot patterns in gold along the hems, long fitted sleeves, a soft high collar; barefoot with the gold anklets; above her head several thin golden halo rings, and slim golden pendulum ornaments hanging in the air around her; one golden ring floats beside her right hand like the dial of a sundial. Standing with the violet-tinged hands loosely together, eyes lowered.
art: A large close portrait: lowered golden eyes and a sad, gentle half-smile, violet-tinged fingers raised near her cheek, silver hair drifting like falling sand; warm golden light from above on one side; blurred golden pendulum ornaments and drifting motes of light in the foreground.

name: 生之执政·纳贝里士
src: 底卡 #97、#98（显相、一体双魂）；门面重做_方向稿.md 第五节；语料/门面参考_11-10/执政_纳贝里士.webp
ref_lead: The LAST attached picture shows this being's original design, for the details only: take from it the hair colour and hairstyle, the mismatched eyes, the hood and veil, the forehead ornament, the gold collar and the golden spiral behind her. Do NOT copy its pose, its camera angle, its body shape or how open its neckline is: here she is a dignified, fully dressed adult woman whose clothes follow the descriptions below. Ignore its rendering and background.
who: Naberius, the Shade of Life, in the shape of a grown woman who looks about twenty-seven, about 174 cm, tall and composed. Long hair to the waist, warm honey-brown at the crown fading into pale gold toward the ends; mismatched eyes, her own left eye gold and her own right eye a pale silver-blue, each pupil carrying a faint twin-spiral pattern; a cool, aloof, scholarly face with a sharp mind behind it, and now and then a reckless grin that belongs to the other soul sharing her body. A gold ornament on her forehead whose small stone glows faintly gold or blue. A slim gold collar at the throat.
palette: deep blue, gold, warm gold-beige, a touch of pale blue
casual: Walking among the living like a travelling scholar: a deep blue hooded cloak with the hood down over a buttoned dark waistcoat, a long-sleeved cream blouse and a long dark skirt, a satchel at the hip, a slim book stuffed with pressed leaves and seeds under one arm, the gold collar and forehead ornament worn small.
private: At rest: the hood off and the hair loose, a long gold-beige house gown with fitted sleeves, a small potted seedling held in both hands, one eyebrow raised in a slightly exasperated half-smile.
formal: As the Shade of Life: a hooded mantle with a long flowing veil, deep blue outside and warm gold-beige inside, over a fitted dark blue gown with gold trim, long sleeves and a closed neckline, the gold collar at the throat and the gold forehead ornament; behind her a softly glowing golden double spiral, two strands twining around each other, with a small white flower blooming at its centre. Standing straight, one hand raised as if making a point in a lecture.
art: A large close portrait: the mismatched gold and silver-blue eyes, one eyebrow raised, the corner of the mouth caught between a stern line and a reckless grin; light from one side, gold on one half of the face and cool blue on the other; the glowing double spiral behind her; blurred seed heads and white petals in the foreground.
faces_extra: In these head-and-shoulders shots leave out the golden spiral and the flower behind her: nothing floats behind her head, no arc, no ring, no curved shape of any kind; only her hood, hair and collar.

name: 空之执政·阿斯莫代
src: 底卡 #97、#101（显相）；门面重做_方向稿.md 第五节；语料/门面参考_11-10/执政_阿斯莫代.png；11-15 第二回：用户给的两张官方图（archon_asmoday_ref1、ref2），发型和本相照它；11-15 第三回：常服、正装的发束往上拉高到两个头高（用户：“阿斯莫代常服正装头发往上的可以长一些”）；11-15 第四回：三套立绘的头发都照私服放下来，只有艺术照的头发自然往上散（用户：“干脆就给阿斯莫代的立绘头发都改成私服那种往下的吧，只有艺术照是往上散发（看起来也不要是刻意的往上）”）
ref_lead: The LAST 2 attached pictures show this exact being's official design. Follow them closely for her cloud-white hair colour, her golden eyes, and the design of her formal dress: the white close-fitting high-collared dress, the black pointed shoulder pieces, the glowing golden ornament at the throat, the long red train flowing behind her, deep red fading to dark and sprinkled with small star-like sparkles, the long gold ribbon streamers, the white legs and the black and red heels. Do NOT copy their hairstyle: her hair is never swept up, it hangs loose down her back. Do NOT copy their poses or camera angles: she stands upright. Leave out the pedestal she stands on. Ignore their rendering and background.
who: Asmoday, the Shade of Space, in the shape of a grown woman who looks about twenty-eight, about 178 cm, tall, straight-backed and severe. Long, thick cloud-white hair worn loose, falling over her shoulders and down her back to below the hips in soft large waves, the ends fading to a pale grey-violet, a few locks framing the face and one thin strand standing up at the crown; dark gold eyes with cross-shaped star pupils, always looking down from above, cold and haughty; pale skin. She seems less a living thing than a law standing upright.
palette: white, black, dark red, dark gold
casual: Among the living, unmistakably aloof: a long white tailored greatcoat buttoned all the way up to a high black collar that closes at the throat, no open neckline, black pointed shoulder pieces, the right sleeve black traced with thin gold lines, black gloves, white fitted trousers and black heeled boots, her long white hair hanging loose down her back, the hands clasped behind her back.
private: Alone: a simple white high-necked gown with long sleeves, her long white hair loose and spreading behind her like a drift of cloud, a small deep-red cube turning slowly above one gloved fingertip.
formal: As the Shade of Space, in her official dress: a white close-fitting high-collared dress with sharp clean lines, black pointed shoulder pieces like folded blades, a glowing golden ornament at the throat, the right arm in a long black glove traced with gold lines and ending in pointed fingertips; from the waist a long train that flows behind her, deep red fading to black and sprinkled with small star-like sparkles, with long gold ribbon streamers; white tights and black and red high heels; a few small deep-red cubes floating near her shoulders; a long blade of red, black and gold floating point-down beside her, no taller than she is. Standing very upright, chin raised, looking down at the viewer.
art: A large close portrait seen from a little below: dark gold eyes with cross-shaped star pupils looking down, cold and haughty, her long loose white hair lifted by a slow draught rising from the cracking space around her, the strands drifting up and outward softly and unevenly as if weightless, never gathered, combed or styled into any shape, the golden ornament at her throat glowing, the air around her cracking like a mirror into red and black shards; hard white light with a red rim light; blurred red cubes and star sparkles in the foreground.
faces_extra: Her long hair hangs loose down around her shoulders; nothing is swept up above her head.
